hexspark-4.note: The marked foe survives the first spark, Hexed. The second spark kills it, and it bursts in a violet nova.

hexspark-5.note: This is the 3rd cast, so black lightning strikes two more foes.

lightbolt-2.note: Two bolts in a row: the second light hit on the marked foe calls down the beam.

lightbolt-5.note: This is the 4th bolt: a small sun.

wither-3.note: The marked foe withers away, and its wither passes to a foe nearby.

emberbolt-4.note: Foes behind the pack walk over the burning tile.

emberbolt-5.note: The marked foe is Armoured and has 1 HP: the Fire Bolt kills it and it leaves molten steel.

frostshard-4.note: Each hit has a 25% chance to freeze its foe solid; here one does.

frostshard-5.note: This is the 3rd cast: a great lance of ice drives through the line.

staticspark-2.note: Three foes have 1 HP: the spark kills them and leaves sparks on the ground.

staticspark-4.note: Three foes have 1 HP; a foe the spark kills has a 35% chance to explode, and here one does.

staticspark-3.note: Each leap has a 25% chance to stun: the one that will stun charges violet first.

cinders-2.note: A raven flies over the smoke.

thornwhip-5.note: The ram is the toughest foe nearby: the rose whip goes for it.

darkpulse-4.note: The wall of dark energy strikes flyers too.

lantern-4.note: Two foes have 1 HP: the lantern kills them and gathers their souls for a stronger beam.

rimebloom-3.note: A Frost Shard follows the bloom and shatters a Brittle foe.

catchflame-2.note: The marked foe has 1 HP: it dies burning and erupts.

catchflame-5.note: Eleven foes, so the fire can reach its tenth.

firewall-4.note: Six foes cross the wall, so it releases its blast.

riftfang-4.note: The blackglass spears hit flyers too.

stormcloud-0.note: One cloud gathers over the leading foe, one over the strongest (the ram).

stormcloud-1.note: One cloud gathers over the leading foe, one over the strongest (the ram).

stormcloud-2.note: One cloud gathers over the leading foe, one over the strongest (the ram).

stormcloud-3.note: One cloud gathers over the leading foe, one over the strongest (the ram).

stormcloud-4.note: One cloud gathers over the leading foe, one over the strongest (the ram).

verdict-2.note: Foes behind the pack cross the scar.

stormcloud-5.note: One cloud gathers over the leading foe, one over the strongest (the ram).

verdict-5.note: The second beam hits flyers too.

icetomb-0.note: The ram is the strongest foe: the tomb always takes the strongest.

icetomb-1.note: The ram is the strongest foe: the tomb always takes the strongest.

icetomb-2.note: The ram is the strongest foe: the tomb always takes the strongest.

icetomb-3.note: The ram is the strongest foe: the tomb always takes the strongest.

icetomb-4.note: The ram is the strongest foe: the tomb always takes the strongest.

icetomb-5.note: The ram is the strongest foe: the tomb always takes the strongest.

frostwolves-5.note: At the end both wolves leap at the strongest foe, the ram.

stormcaller-2.note: A cloud rains on the pack and Soaks it: a bolt on a Soaked foe runs through the water to the others.

stormcaller-1.note: Bolts that would land near a foe bend onto it.

stormcaller-3.note: The thunder of each strike rolls along the road.

stormcaller-4.note: From 8s to 11s of the storm it marches down the road toward the keep as a front of bolts (the clip joins it there).

chronostasis-1.note: As time breaks every foe inside is wound back along the road.

stormcaller-5.note: As the storm ends its clouds draw into one thunderhead for a last colossal bolt (the clip joins it there).

chronostasis-2.note: A great clock hand sweeps the field every 2 seconds.

chronostasis-3.note: As time catches up the echoes rush back into their foes (the clip joins the field near its end).

chronostasis-4.note: Archer towers that reach into the field shoot 30% faster.

chronostasis-5.note: The collapse, then a ghost of the field collapses again (the clip joins the field near its end).

glacialrift-1.note: The frozen foes stand as ice statues; foes walking up behind them are stopped until they thaw.

glacialrift-2.note: The wave drags each foe a tile back up the road.

glacialrift-3.note: Slabs of ice break off the ridge and crash onto the road.

glacialrift-4.note: Rime gathers on every foe in the blizzard, even far behind the rift, until it freezes solid.

glacialrift-5.note: As the ridge shatters the rift tears open and its fangs slam shut.

harvest-1.note: Three foes are low on health: the scythe leaves them under 15% and they are reaped outright.

harvest-2.note: Three foes have 1 HP: the first sweep reaps them and their souls hurl out on the backhand.

harvest-4.note: The souls stay with the hero; the next scroll (a Dark Pulse) takes them and is stronger.

harvest-3.note: Low-health foes die withering, and burst into new clouds of Wither.

harvest-5.note: A skeletal hand rises under the strongest foe, the ram, and tears its soul out.

dslash-1.note: The edge burns white and the cut runs wider: the foes beside the road are struck too.

dslash-2.note: The tear opens wider and darker, stays open longer and shreds harder.

dslash-3.note: The world stands still a beat longer: the foes on the line are held until space splits, and it splits harder.

dslash-4.note: Three foes are worn down: the split leaves them under 20% of their health, and cuts them down.

bloom-1.note: Foes past the flower turn back to it; foes behind it hurry on.

dslash-5.note: The tear yawns open along the whole line, and when it seals it snaps shut on everything inside it.

bloom-2.note: An archer tower shoots a bound foe: a quarter of each arrow runs along the vines.

bloom-3.note: 16 razor petals whirl out of the burst and slice into the foes.

bloom-4.note: The pack walks on through the pollen: the cloud drifts with it.

bloom-5.note: The flower goes to seed: seeds drift onto the foes and sprout small blooms.

loop-1.note: Foes the fold sends back come out turned around and walk the wrong way for a moment, a U-turn of light circling them.

loop-2.note: Each foe the fold sends back is sheared where it goes in and where it comes out.

loop-3.note: Fast foes, so they go round the 8-tile loop more than once: each lap hurts more.

loop-4.note: Archer towers shoot the foes the fold sent back: they take more from everything for 3s.

treant-2.note: The foes walk into the oak: it lowers its trunk and charges through them, throwing them to the sides of the road.

loop-5.note: The fold holds 10 seconds; when it lets go the looped road snaps back.

treant-3.note: A second knot of foes further back: every third slam it hurls a boulder at it.

treant-4.note: Entangling Roots first: each Overgrown foe it slams adds a growth ring; at four, its next slam is a Grove Slam.

treant-5.note: At the end of its 10 seconds it topples forward along the road.

compress-1.note: The foes are spread out: the squeeze draws them together.

compress-3.note: Its two smaller squeezes snap first.

compress-5.note: A star of pressed light bursts after the snap.

prism-2.note: A seventh, white sunbeam locks onto the toughest foe, the ram, and burns hotter the longer it holds.

prism-3.note: The folding beams set the foes ringing like bells: the lance’s power runs through them into the foes beside them.

prism-4.note: Foes swept by all six colours burst with them.

voidfall-1.note: The front of the pack has walked past the impact: the sphere drags it back.

voidfall-4.note: Archer towers shoot the Hollowed foes; the void gives a share back at once when it ends.

judgment-1.note: The circle snaps back to a point and fires a second line through the foes the first one missed.

voidfall-5.note: A second sphere holds the lifted foes in the air, then implodes.

judgment-2.note: Every line strikes harder, pierces wider and burns brighter.

judgment-4.note: Three foes are worn down: the line leaves them under a quarter of their health, and finishes them off.

judgment-3.note: Three more circles open in a fan behind the hand and fire one after another.

judgment-5.note: Ten circles fill the air behind the hero and fire in turn: fifteen lines in one cast.

cataclysm-1.note: Seven standing stones rise in a ring at the rune’s edge: the foes walking through are fenced in until the sky falls.

cataclysm-4.note: The foes the collapse hits are studded with obsidian: each tower hit knocks a shard into the foe beside it.

cataclysm-5.note: The pillars spin up and slam down on the toughest foes nearby.

phoenix-1.note: Eleven foes: its fifth strike sets it white-hot, a third bigger, and it burns hotter from then on.

phoenix-2.note: As it climbs away a front of flame races back along its river of fire.

phoenix-3.note: Its burst becomes burning feathers that dart at the foes it struck, the toughest (the ram) first.

phoenix-4.note: Its fire erupts on foes that are already burning.

phoenix-5.note: Its death burst rains ashes on the foes it struck: each that dies is reborn as a firebird that dives at the next.

comet-1.note: The pack walks briskly: the comet steers onto where it will be.

comet-2.note: Foes still marching in under its tail.

comet-4.note: A Frost Spire’s ice shatters the fractured foes.

comet-5.note: The heart bursts out of the crater and smashes into the toughest foe nearby, the ram.

wyrm-2.note: As it weaves, its head lunges and snaps shut on the foes within reach.

wyrm-3.note: It seizes the toughest foe near its head, the ram, and squeezes it.

wyrm-4.note: Each lash rings its foe with lightning; its strike forks to every ringed foe.

eclipse-2.note: The heavy gold beams fall far more often.

eclipse-1.note: The star beams strike harder and wider, and burst up in starfire where they land.

eclipse-3.note: A star every 0.0625s: about 35 beams from a brighter sky.

embertitan-1.note: The greatsword is longer and white-hot.

embertitan-3.note: The blast at the blade’s tip strikes harder and wider.

embertitan-2.note: Foes far back up the road: the fissure tears 14 tiles down it and burns longer.

eclipse-5.note: The sun breaks: the shatter strikes every foe on the map, the ones further back too.

eclipse-4.note: Eleven foes: each star picks a foe no star has struck yet and lands on it.

embertitan-4.note: Foes under the blade are stunned 1.2s; the boss (an Ogre) 0.4s.

embertitan-5.note: The whole fissure tears open as the sword lands: every geyser bursts at once.

eternalwinter-1.note: The frost strikes harder as it reaches each foe, and leaves larger ice.

eternalwinter-2.note: The Heart gathers itself longer: the foes stay frozen, then slowed, longer.

eternalwinter-3.note: When the Heart bursts, six shards fly at the nearest foes.

eternalwinter-4.note: The boss (an Ogre) stays frozen until the wave reaches it.

eternalwinter-5.note: The shatter wave strikes 1500%: the ice sheet bursts up as it breaks.

aeon-0.note: The dial forms and its great hand starts to turn (the first 12 seconds of the cast).

aeon-1.note: Each pass of the great hand takes 2% of a foe’s max health.

aeon-2.note: Each pass ages the foes slower, up to 50%.

aeon-3.note: The hand turns every 2.56s: more sweeps before midnight.

aeon-5.note: Midnight tolls twelve times (the clip joins the dial at midnight); foes left under 25% crumble.

aeon-4.note: Archer towers fight 30% faster while the dial turns, glinting gold as the hand passes.

pulsar-0.note: The neutron star rises and its beam sweeps its ring (the first 11 seconds of the cast).

pulsar-1.note: Every beam hit strikes harder; the beams burn thicker.

pulsar-2.note: Every phase comes sooner and the star spins faster.

pulsar-3.note: The second beam tips down and sweeps a second, smaller ring.

pulsar-5.note: Supernova: the implosion draws the rings in, and the blast reaches 8.5 tiles (the clip joins it there).

pulsar-4.note: The pack walks on over the burnt ground: it sears them.

singularity-1.note: The hole takes hold sooner and holds longer, drawn larger.

singularity-3.note: Three foes are low on health: each that dies while pinned feeds the hole.

singularity-2.note: The drain tears harder at the pinned foes.

singularity-4.note: Rocks tear up from beneath every pinned foe, one a second.

singularity-5.note: The collapse strikes every foe on the map for 500%.

wormhole-1.note: Here a second road joins the first: the first wormhole yawns wider and draws in foes from both roads (knights from the other road, labelled).

wormhole-2.note: The wormholes stay open longer, so the foes further back walk in too.

wormhole-3.note: Every foe that goes through is struck and thrown 16 tiles back.

wormhole-4.note: The boss (an Ogre) goes through too, and comes out 5 tiles back, slowed.

wormhole-5.note: Slow foes still short of the mouth as it closes: it swallows them, then both wormholes collapse.

never-1.note: A shooting star every 0.36s, splashing wider.

never-2.note: Time stands still longer, and the foes held in it take 50% more.

never-3.note: Four stars lash more often, over a wider square.

never-5.note: The last fall: the great stars land for real (the clip joins it there).

never-4.note: Foes move 50% slower, and the archer towers attack 35% faster.

tempest-1.note: The crown bolt strikes every foe on the field and leaves them Charged.

tempest-0.note: The hurricane forms round the hero, its eye wall rising (the first 13 seconds of the cast).

tempest-2.note: Every volley locks onto one more foe.

tempest-5.note: The last thunder, and the hero’s fall rolls out over the whole field (the clip joins it there).

tempest-3.note: Each precise strike leaps on further and harder.

tempest-4.note: The lightning racing round the eye wall strikes the foes it passes.

purgatory-0.note: The judgment gathers round the hero and its cuts begin (the first 13 seconds of the cast).

purgatory-1.note: The foes are spread along the road: the judgment reaches further.

purgatory-2.note: The last stage begins at 13s and cuts faster (the clip joins it there).

purgatory-3.note: The six eyes stare: foes where they look are cut as if they stood close to the hero.

purgatory-4.note: Three foes are worn down: a cut that leaves them under 8% cuts them down.

purgatory-5.note: The silence holds, then every foe takes one last cut (the clip joins it there).

bloodneedles-1.note: Each needle strikes harder: longer, with brighter tips and trails.

bloodneedles-2.note: The pack walks on: the needles fly faster and turn tighter, so few arrive late.

bloodneedles-3.note: A needle striking a foe already pierced strikes harder for every needle in it.

bloodneedles-4.note: One foe with 1 HP: the first needle kills it, the rest wait glowing in the orbit, and fly at the foes that come next.

bloodneedles-5.note: The orbit fills to 12 and, after 24 have flown, looses all at once at the strongest foe (the ram).

gaia-1.note: Each tree tears up harder and reaches further.

gaia-4.note: The keep mends 3 lives; a green column rises at the keep.

gaia-3.note: Foes behind the pack walk into the standing trees and are struck and pinned too.

gaia-2.note: Foes a tree strikes are pinned longer, roots splaying from every trunk.

seraphlance-2.note: It lands like a falling star: a 4-tile blast.

gaia-5.note: Every tree sheds its leaves, and as the forest sinks it drags its foes down.

seraphlance-1.note: The great lance is forged longer and brighter.

seraphlance-3.note: Nine lances leave the wings after the great one.

seraphlance-5.note: Every lance from the wings strikes like a lesser great lance.

seraphlance-4.note: The lances stay standing in their foes and hold them.

shatter-1.note: The break strikes harder; thicker shards with coloured edges.

shatter-3.note: The twist turns further and drags at the foes inside.

shatter-2.note: Foes stay held 1.2s after the break; the shards hang still at the top of their flight.

shatter-4.note: Three foes are worn down: the break leaves them under 25%, and they break apart with it.

vael-1.note: The storm grows wilder faster: some 26 strikes.

shatter-5.note: The sheet of shards bursts up and rains back down on the foes.

vael-2.note: Every strike that lands arcs on into one or two foes nearby.

vael-3.note: Every foe in the storm joins the network, and it tears harder at them.

vael-4.note: The pack walks on: the storm re-centres and glides after it.

vael-5.note: The final strike hits 1260% within 3.2 tiles; the crater stays live longer.

bloodeye-2.note: Branded foes take 40% more from everything, for 10s.

bloodeye-3.note: The blood lightning lashes every brand 7 times.

bloodeye-1.note: Eleven foes: the eye brands 7 within 10 tiles.

bloodeye-4.note: Three foes are low on health: when a branded foe dies the gaze swings to the strongest unbranded one.

bloodeye-5.note: Before the lids close, one great lash strikes every brand at once.

moonfall-1.note: The foes are spread out: the fuller moon’s impact reaches 4.6 tiles.

moonfall-2.note: The crater of molten blood spreads wider and burns longer; foes behind walk into it.

moonfall-3.note: The moon’s 16 shards are thrown at the foes round the crater.

moonfall-4.note: The pack walks on: under the falling moon’s shadow it slows.

moonfall-5.note: Moonbreaker: a wave of blood rolls out to 10.6 tiles and strikes the foes further back.

constellation-1.note: The stars burn larger and fall as thicker lances.

constellation-3.note: The lines burn wider and stay alight: foes behind walk onto them.

constellation-2.note: Eleven foes: the figure kindles over the 8 strongest.

constellation-4.note: The pack walks on: each foe under a star is held there until it falls.

constellation-5.note: When the lines have burnt the figure kindles again and falls a second time.

bloodcurse-2.note: Every eruption strikes harder, its columns taller and hotter.

bloodcurse-3.note: Each stage of the escalation grows the eruptions 18%.

bloodcurse-4.note: Each greater scroll the curse seals on the hero makes every eruption stronger.

bloodcurse-5.note: The final eruption is half again as large, and the blast after it strikes 1500%.

abyss-1.note: Foes drown faster: streams of bubbles rise off every one.

abyss-0.note: The sea rises over the field and its leviathans hunt (the first 13 seconds of the cast).

abyss-3.note: The leviathans lunge more often, bite harder and reach further.

abyss-2.note: The pack walks on: the sea slows it 70%.

abyss-5.note: Halfway through the eldest leviathan bursts up out of the deep and joins the hunt (the clip joins it there).

abyss-4.note: A foe a leviathan bites drowns 50% faster, a column of bubbles rising from it.

citadel-0.note: The domain rises and its cuts begin (the first 13 seconds of the cast).

citadel-1.note: The foes are spread out: the domain reaches 6 tiles.

citadel-2.note: Each cut strikes harder, and harder in its wake.

citadel-5.note: The final fracture tears across the domain (the clip joins it near its end).

citadel-3.note: The pack walks on: inside the domain it crawls.

expanse-0.note: The void swallows the land and its cuts begin (the first 13 seconds of the cast).

expanse-1.note: Every cut strikes harder, with wider, whiter strokes.

citadel-4.note: Each cut aims at the foe nearest the keep no cut has struck yet, and throws it back.

expanse-2.note: Eleven foes: more cuts a second.

expanse-5.note: In the last 3 seconds great screen-wide cuts, then one last cut on every foe as reality returns (the clip joins it there).

expanse-3.note: The pack walks on: in the void it crawls at 15%.

expanse-4.note: Four foes are worn down: a cut leaves them under 15%, and they are erased.

firsttree-0.note: The tree rises and its roots begin to burst (the first 13 seconds of the cast).

firsttree-1.note: Each eruption reaches further, with more root spikes.

firsttree-2.note: The roots drink twice as much; motes of life fly to the trunk.

firsttree-3.note: The roots burst more often and strike the same foe again sooner.

firsttree-5.note: The world in bloom: the bloom strikes harder for every foe the roots drank from (the clip joins it there).

firsttree-4.note: Three foes are worn down: the roots leave them under 20% and drag them under the earth.
